integrity: The included Python script enumerates triple atomic diagrams directly and tests closed-form signatures; its output is reproduced verbatim. The all-parameter conclusion rests on the mathematical proof; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only pure undirected adjacency/equality rank-three logic on nonempty Cartesian products of complete graphs with every factor order at least two. No claim about higher ranks or richer logics. Two earlier graph-paper comparisons are abstract-level; equivalent unindexed literature remains possible. Computational checks are finite and do not replace the infinite proof.
title: Nine rank-three theories of mixed Hamming graphs
